Delivery is through the public Schema API.

v1.kill_reason: Round-trip grading (Schema->JSON Schema->Schema) is lossy and the mapping is unspecified; upstream's own importer is documented best-effort, so a different valid solution would fail or pass arbitrarily. Also the decoder premise and the Standard Schema bridge overlap merged upstream code (SchemaRepresentation importer, toStandardSchemaV1), and the seed's pinned commit (1b74086) differs from the probe commit (a9f0ca68). Re-scope to an exact-fidelity keyword subset with a written mapping spec and a pre-July 2026 base to resubmit.

spike_plan.kill_if: Build cannot be made offline-deterministic, or the round-trip oracle cannot be specified without encoding the reference's internal mapping choices, or the base snapshot would need to be pre-July 2026 with the decoder scope already public.
spike_plan.pass_if: Build succeeds offline with pinned toolchain, per-test JSON results are produced deterministically, and round-trip failure set is small and explainable by a fixed mapping spec.
steps: In a networked throwaway Linux container, clone Effect-TS/effect at 1b74086 and at a9f0ca68; record which commit the seed's probe actually built.
grep-free check: confirm whether SchemaRepresentation.fromJsonSchemaDocument exists and which merged PRs (#6781, #8657) are in the head tree; find the last commit before 2026-07-30 as candidate base.
Run corepack pnpm install and the build command from smoke_build; record the exact failure (lockfile, corepack, network) and the pinned pnpm version needed.
Run pnpm vitest run for the Schema package with --reporter=json and check per-test results and determinism over 3 runs.
Sample 20 generated Schema ASTs, run Schema->JSONSchema.make->SchemaRepresentation import->Schema, and count exact-equality round-trip failures to measure lossiness.
Decide whether the decoder subset can be specified exactly enough that two independent implementations agree; if not, re-scope.

v1.summary: Effect Schema multi-part feature with real MIT source, but the reverse JSON Schema decoder already exists in merged upstream code (SchemaRepresentation.fromJsonSchemaDocument, PRs #6781 and #8657) and the Standard Schema bridge already ships, so the premise is partly public. Round-trip grading is lossy and unspecified, and the smoke build is red offline, so it is killed as K4 pending a re-scoped version.
